children.prompt: Work out the perpendicular height of the pyramid, to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
Let $O$ be the centre of the square base. Then $OM=3\text{ cm}$ and triangle $EOM$ is right-angled at $O$.
$\begin{aligned}EO^2&=(\sqrt{91})^2-3^2\\EO&=\sqrt{82}\\EO&\approx9.1\text{ cm}\quad\text{(1 d.p.)}\end{aligned}$
